decisions.briefing: Market was neutral (NASDAQ +0.7%, S&P500 +0.3%) with cash at just $89.29, well below the $500 deployment threshold, so no new buys were made. All 7 existing positions were held since none hit stop-loss or profit-target levels, consistent with letting winners run through neutral sessions.

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices posted modest gains today, with the NASDAQ outpacing the S&P 500, suggesting mild risk appetite without a decisive directional catalyst. Many of the top-scoring screener candidates show RSI readings above 70, indicating they are already extended after recent rallies. With no fresh capital available to deploy, the market's neutral tone reinforced a hold-steady approach rather than chasing overbought names.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市溫和上揚，納指升0.7%，標普500升0.3%，反映投資者風險偏好輕微回升，惟未見明確方向性利好因素帶動。篩選名單中多隻高分股份的RSI已超過70，顯示短期升勢已見過熱。由於現金儲備不足，未有新增買盤，繼續維持現有持倉部署。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: When a stock's RSI climbs above 70, it's considered 'overbought' — meaning the price has risen quickly and may be due for a pause or pullback, even if the underlying trend is still positive. Many of today's top-scoring candidates were deep in overbought territory, which is a reason to be cautious about chasing them at current prices.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 當股票的RSI（相對強弱指標）升穿70，即被視為「超買」，意味股價短期升幅過急，隨時面臨回調風險，即使長期趨勢仍然向好。今日不少高分候選股份的RSI已處於超買水平，故此時追入須格外謹慎。
